message: duplicate handler for `V_sig` in the same scope
why: Handlers are collected per scope. Two for one signal in one scope would both be candidates, and which one runs is decided by binding order — that is not something a reader can see, so the program's behaviour would depend on an invisible ordering.
fix: merge the two handlers into one
or move one into a nested block — the list is per scope, so a nested scope may declare its own
